arxiv-2006-09544.title: Supersymmetry of 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} - symmetric tridiagonal Hamiltonians
arxiv-2006-09544.creator: Mohammad Walid AlMasri
arxiv-2006-09544.description: Abstract We extend the study of supersymmetric tridiagonal Hamiltonians to the case of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians with real or complex conjugate eigenvalues. We find the relation between matrix elements of the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian H H and its supersymmetric partner H + H^{+} in a given basis.

arxiv-2111-03099.title: Complete condensation of photon noise in nonlinear dissipative systems
arxiv-2111-03099.creator: Nicholas Rivera 1 , Jamison Sloan 2 , Yannick Salamin 2 , and Marin Soljačić 1,2
arxiv-2111-03099.description: Abstract Fock states are the most fundamental quantum states of bosonic fields, forming an important basis for understanding their quantum dynamics. As energy and number eigenstates, they have an exactly defined number of quanta, and most faithfully express the particle nature of fields.

arxiv-2112-09003.title: Efficient Many-Body Non-Markovian Dynamics of Organic Polaritons
arxiv-2112-09003.creator: Piper Fowler-Wright, Brendon W. Lovett, Jonathan Keeling
arxiv-2112-09003.description: Abstract We show how to simulate a model of many molecules with both strong coupling to many vibrational modes and collective coupling to a single photon mode. We do this by combining process tensor matrix product operator methods with a mean-field approximation which reduces the dimension of the problem.

arxiv-2211-02738.title: Intriguing Properties of Compression on Multilingual Models
arxiv-2211-02738.creator: Kelechi Ogueji, Orevaoghene Ahia, Gbemileke Onilude, Sebastian Gehrmann, Sara Hooker, Julia Kreutzer
arxiv-2211-02738.description: Abstract Multilingual models are often particularly dependent on scaling to generalize to a growing number of languages. Compression techniques are widely relied upon to reconcile the growth in model size with real world resource constraints, but compression can have a disparate effect on model performance for low-resource languages.

arxiv-2302-11876.title: Event reconstruction using pattern spectra and convolutional neural networks for the Cherenkov Telescope Array
arxiv-2302-11876.creator: R. F. Peletier
arxiv-2302-11876.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by R. F. Peletier. The Cherenkov Telescope Array (CTA) is the future observatory for ground-based imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescopes. Each telescope will provide a snapshot of gamma-ray induced particle showers by capturing the induced Cherenkov emission at ground level. The simulation of such events provides camera images that can be used as training data for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to differentiate signals from background events and to determine the energy of the initial gamma-ray events.

arxiv-2403-17212.title: Sanity Checks for Explanation Uncertainty
arxiv-2403-17212.creator: Matias Valdenegro-Toro, Mihir Mulye
arxiv-2403-17212.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Matias Valdenegro-Toro, Mihir Mulye. Explanations for machine learning models can be hard to interpret or be wrong. Combining an explanation method with an uncertainty estimation method produces explanation uncertainty. Evaluating explanation uncertainty is difficult. In this paper we propose sanity checks for uncertainty explanation methods, where a weight and data randomization tests are defined for explanations with uncertainty, allowing for quick tests to combinations of uncertainty and explanation methods.

arxiv-2407-13094.title: Rethinking Video-Text Understanding: Retrieval from Counterfactually Augmented Data
arxiv-2407-13094.creator: Wufei Ma, Kai Li, Zhongshi Jiang, Moustafa Meshry, Qihao Liu, Huiyu Wang, Christian Häne, Alan Yuille
arxiv-2407-13094.description: Abstract Recent video-text foundation models have demonstrated strong performance on a wide variety of downstream video understanding tasks. Can these video-text models genuinely understand the contents of natural videos? Standard video-text evaluations could be misleading as many questions can be inferred merely from the objects and contexts in a single frame or biases inherent in the datasets.

arxiv-2410-23475.title: Measurements of inclusive and differential cross sections for top quark production in association with a \PZ boson in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2410-23475.description: Abstract Measurements are presented of inclusive and differential cross sections for \PZ boson associated production of top quark pairs ( \ttbar ​ \PZ \ttbar\PZ ) and single top quarks ( \PQt ​ \PZ ​ \PQq \PQt\PZ\PQq or \PQt ​ \PW ​ \PZ \PQt\PW\PZ ).

arxiv-2411-07748.title: Étale geometry of closures of Jordan classes
arxiv-2411-07748.creator: Filippo Ambrosio
arxiv-2411-07748.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Filippo Ambrosio. Let G G be a connected reductive algebraic group with simply connected derived subgroup. Over the complex numbers there exists a local method to study the geometric properties of a point g g in the closure of a Jordan class of G G in terms of Jordan classes of a maximal rank reductive subgroup M ≤ G M\leq G depending on the point g g , and further to the closures of certain decomposition classes in Lie ⁡ M \operatorname{Lie}M .

arxiv-2411-11673.title: Anomalous Spectroscopical Effects in an Antiferromagnetic Semiconductor
arxiv-2411-11673.creator: M. Hubert, T. Maleček, K.–H. Ahn, M. Míšek, J. Železný, F. Máca, G. Springholz, M. Veis, K. Výborný
arxiv-2411-11673.description: Abstract Following the recent observation of anomalous Hall effect in antiferromagnetic hexagonal MnTe thin films, related phenomena at finite frequencies have come into focus. Magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) is the key material property here. In the x-ray range, the XMCD has already been demonstrated and used to visualise domains via photoemission electron microscopy (PEEM).

arxiv-2506-07473.title: An introduction to pitch strength in contemporary popular music analysis and production In Music 2024, Innovation in Music Conference 14-16 June, 2024, Kristiania University College, Oslo, Norway
arxiv-2506-07473.creator: Emmanuel Deruty
arxiv-2506-07473.description: Abstract Music information retrieval distinguishes between low- and high-level descriptions of music. Current generative AI models rely on text descriptions that are higher level than the controls familiar to studio musicians. Pitch strength, a low-level perceptual parameter of contemporary popular music, may be one feature that could make such AI models more suited to music production.

pmc-10609957.title: Bispecific Antibodies in Lung Cancer: A State-of-the-Art Review
pmc-10609957.creator: Atulya Aman Khosla, Karan Jatwani, Rohit Singh, Aswanth Reddy, Ishmael Jaiyesimi, Aakash Desai, Giorgio Cozza
pmc-10609957.description: Bispecific antibodies have emerged as a promising class of therapeutics in the field of oncology, offering an innovative approach to target cancer cells while sparing healthy tissues. These antibodies are designed to bind two different antigens, enabling them to bridge immune cells with cancer cells, resulting in enhanced tumor cell killing and improved treatment responses.

pmc-11395910.title: Association between healthy lifestyle and frailty in adults and mediating role of weight-adjusted waist index: results from NHANES
pmc-11395910.creator: Shibo Liu, Xiangjun Pan, Bo Chen, Dapeng Zeng, Shenghao Xu, Ruiyan Li, Xiongfeng Tang, Yanguo Qin
pmc-11395910.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe relationship between healthy lifestyle and frailty remains unclear. Healthy weight is crucial for overall well-being, but using body mass index (BMI) to evaluate weight management is inefficient. This study clarifies the association between healthy lifestyle or its factors (non-smoking, moderate drinking, healthy weight, healthy diet, sufficeint physical activity, and non-sedentary) and frailty, and the feasibility of using the weight-adjusted waist index (WWI) reflecting central obesity as an intermediate indicator.MethodsThis study included 4,473 participants from the 2007–2018 National Health and Nutrition Examination

pmc-12594787.title: Socio-demographic and clinical factors show no clear association with patient-reported rehabilitation outcomes in schizophrenia
pmc-12594787.creator: Guillaume Barbalat, Julien Plasse, Isabelle Chéreau-Boudet, Benjamin Gouache, Emilie Legros-Lafarge, Nathalie Guillard-Bouhet, Nicolas Franck
pmc-12594787.description: In schizophrenia, patient-reported rehabilitation outcomes provide a unique perspective that goes beyond standard clinical practice, which has traditionally relied on socio-demographic and basic clinical data for diagnosis and treatment decisions. However, there is ongoing debate about whether these routinely collected data meaningfully align with patients’ rehabilitation goals.

pmc-13083910.title: Antimicrobial use at the end of life: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13083910.creator: Klara Sandqvist, Magnus Ekström
pmc-13083910.description: Antibiotic resistance poses a global threat. Antibiotics are administered to 80–90% of terminally ill patients but evidence of their effectiveness in improving survival or symptom relief at the end of life (EOL) is scarce. To determine the proportion of deceased patients that continue antibiotic treatment after documented EOL discussion and the decision to prioritise symptom relief over active treatment.

pmc-13146367.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1397 COGNITIVE AND NEUROIMAGING PROFILE OF SPORADIC CEREBRAL AMYLOID ANGIOPATHY PATIENTS WITH PHOSPHORYLATED TAU POSITIVITY
pmc-13146367.creator: Amar Valentin, Quentin Beaufort, Alix Launay, Diane Dufour, Wallon David, Boulouis Grégoire, Lou Grangeon, Anna Chloé Balageas, Marco Pasi
pmc-13146367.description: Background and aimsPhosphorylated tau (pTau) in cerebrospinal fluid is a hallmark biomarker of Alzheimer’s disease (AD); however, its significance as a marker of AD co-pathology in sporadic cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA) remains unclear. This study aimed to characterize the cognitive and neuroimaging profile of pTau-positive CAA patients (CAApT+).

pmc-13184291.title: The potential role of transcranial direct current stimulation in experimental ischemic stroke in adult male albino rats
pmc-13184291.creator: Omar Ahmed Abdelbary, Nevert Farid Abdelsalam, Dalia Alaa El-Din Aly El-Waseef, Nevine El Nahas, Shaimaa Khedr, Walter C Low, Andrew W Grande
pmc-13184291.description: Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) is a noninvasive neuromodulatory technique with potential therapeutic applications in stroke, but the mechanisms underlying its neuroprotective effects in acute ischemia remain unclear. To evaluate the effects of cathodal versus anodal tDCS on neurobehavioral outcomes, histopathological changes, and inflammatory and glial responses in a rat model of focal cerebral ischemia.

pmc-13253382.title: Harnessing interpretable deep learning to predict resistance in Klebsiella pneumoniae
pmc-13253382.creator: Nicolas da Matta Freire Araujo, Márcia da Silva Chagas, Mateus Fernandes Santos, Renata Freire Alves Pereira, Rafaela Correia Brum, Felipe Ramos Pinheiro, Melise Chaves Silveira, Felicita Mabel Duré, Beatriz de Lima Alessio Müller, Audrien Alves Andrade de Souza, Alessandra Beatriz Santos Rondon Sou
pmc-13253382.description: IntroductionAntimicrobial resistance poses a growing global health threat, complicating therapeutic management and increasing morbidity and mortality. Deep learning methods have emerged as effective tools for bacterial profiling using omics data, particularly in predicting antimicrobial susceptibility from genomic information. The present study focuses on identifying genomic signatures linked to resistance mechanisms using a deep learning architecture.

pmc-13615238.title: Prognostic value of epicardial and pericardial adipose tissue in patients with chronic heart failure
pmc-13615238.creator: Yoran Crum, Dirk J. van Veldhuisen, Michelle Lobeek, Adriaan A. Voors, Michiel Rienstra, Thomas M. Gorter
pmc-13615238.description: BackgroundCentral obesity, rather than overall obesity, may influence heart failure (HF) outcomes. Alternative anthropometric measures remain limited in assessing the actual amount and distribution of visceral adiposity. We hypothesize that epicardial and pericardial adipose tissue (EAT and PAT) are easily obtainable on standard echocardiography and provide prognostic value in patients with HF.

pmc-13658840.title: Enhanced disease resistance in chickpea and canola via MAGPIE: Major‐Effect Allele and Genomic Polygenic Integration for Enhancement
pmc-13658840.creator: Zibei Lin, Irene van den Berg, Shahin Yazdifar, Shimna Sudheesh, Adnan Riaz, Denise Barbulescu, Yongjun Li, Kristy Hobson, Muhammad Ahsan Asif, Matthew Hayden, Sukhjiwan Kaur
pmc-13658840.description: The global agricultural industry suffers major economic losses due to fungal diseases. Though selective breeding and introgression of resistance genes with major effects have helped to reduce the impact of these diseases, resistance breakdown occurs within a few generations. Quantitative resistance that relies on multiple small effect genes has proven to be more durable than relying on major effect genes.
